text:
Gage Goncalves has 3 assists and no goals in 15 games, and if that's all you saw, you'd wonder what happened to the player Evolving-Hockey ranked 32nd among 401 forwards last season. Look closer and the Lightning are winning his minutes: they take almost 60% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, nearly five points better than without him.

The points will come. He's 0 for 13 on shots with 2.1 expected goals, and the on-ice shooting has been unlucky too. Our talent range for his points rate runs from 1.4 to 2.2 per 60 minutes; he's at 0.78. Evolving-Hockey did warn that last season's results ran ahead of his chances, so some cooling was always coming, but not this much.

He's a 2020 second-round pick who spent time in Syracuse before sticking, and last year's defensive numbers were excellent (95th percentile at taking chances away). He played only 10:41 in Saturday's win in Minnesota, the thing we'd watch. We project about 34 points, and on a Tampa team rolling like this, he'll get the minutes to earn them.
headline: Goncalves is better than three points
